desc: Derive the reduction: for a fixed center c and y, keep all neighbor branches b with deg(b)-1 >= y, giving kept = 1 + (y+1)*cnt_c(y), with the optimum at a neighbor's degree threshold.

Implement the branch-centric streaming solution in Python with fast I/O: sort degree >= 2 vertices descending, maintain cnt[c], update best with cnt[c]*deg[v] for each neighbor c, and output N - best - 1.
Verify the implementation on the three public samples and confirm the sweep/tie handling matches the derived formula.
No failing cases; no fallback/debugging required.
